children: Falcon Finance is scheduled to unlock about 203.06 million FF in February 2027. The tokens, equal to 5.73% of the circulating supply, are allocated to the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
The release makes these tokens available to sell. If recipients put some of their unlocked FF on the market, the extra sell orders could put downward pressure on the token's price.

title: Falcon Finance: 203.06 Million FF Unlock in February - Feb 2027
